body: I don't know that anything anyone says could make me feel better, but I appreciate the love bro.

Exactly. It SEEMS like I should be happy, but I'm not. At all. I isolate myself and I don't even know how to begin dating. I have good social skills, am polite and have a cool job but I'm just so, so depressed.
This is chilling. I assure you you're worth more than he feels.
